headline: On 20 held-out seeds in simulated Indian mixed traffic, CHOWK showed no clear difference in delay per person versus area max-pressure (−0.6%, 95% CI −1.5% to +0.0%), with 4.5% lower delay versus Webster fixed-time (95% CI −5.2% to −3.8%). Simulation result.
